task_title: Missed-schedule observability: armed weekly lore timers silently missed their first Monday run
task_criteria: deploy/systemd/README.md documents a post-Monday verification check for each armed timer (report-log mtime or equivalent) with exact paths; a missed run is detectable (dated heartbeat appended by dep-drift.sh even on the no-op path, or an OnFailure/monitor on the units); the run-18 caveat (timer state can say triggered while the service never ran) is present in the systemd arming section

items.detail: deploy/systemd/README.md:52-56 'Post-scheduled-run verification' section gives exact paths and commands (stat -c '%y %n' ~/.local/share/lore/dep-drift.log ~/.local/share/lore/weekly-validate.log; grep -c "heartbeat: $(date +%Y-%m-%d)") with expected post-Monday values per log (README.md:60-70). Detectability verified both ways: (a) heartbeat — scripts/dep-drift.sh:14 EXIT trap emits dated `heartbeat: <ISO-8601> dep-drift.sh ran (rc=<n>)` on every real run; empirical degraded run (34 PyPI lookups forced to fail via LORE_DEP_DRIFT_PYPI=http://127.0.0.1:1/pypi) exited rc=0 with `heartbeat: 2026-11-23T10:33:12-0500 dep-drift.sh ran (rc=0)` as final stdout line; scripts/dep_drift_test.py:79,85 test_noop_run_appends_dated_heartbeat_and_stays_read_only passes (uv run pytest -q scripts/dep_drift_test.py → exit 0, '2 passed in 1.21s'); unit appends stdout via StandardOutput=append:/home/kara/.local/share/lore/dep-drift.log (deploy/systemd/lore-dep-drift.service:15). (b) OnFailure=lore-dep-drift-failure.service at lore-dep-drift.service:8 with dep-drift-failure-notice.sh:6 appending a dated `failure-notice:` line to dep-drift-failures.log. Run-18 caveat present in the arming README (README.md:31-33, heading 'Run-18 caveat: timer state can say triggered while the service never ran') citing docs/qa/evidence/run18/INDEX.md:28 'Timer-miss evidence (LORE-20261012)' which exists with the LastTriggerUSec-vs-empty-journal evidence. Regression tests land in commit 1f24826 'worker: LORE-20261012 make missed timer runs honest'. Full suite fresh run: uv run pytest -x --tb=short → exit 0, '586 passed in 5.08s'.
